question: Which organizations adopt the financial baseline and when, given that institutions differ?
decision: Each real union separately adopts or modifies its financial governance rules through an authorized officer/board in accordance with its constitution; an org admin’s unilateral toggle does not substitute for required institutional approval. No financial write/mandate execution before adoption; staging uses clearly labelled synthetic defaults only.
originalProposedDecision: Each org opts in to the financial baseline through its admin; none is adopted by default.
independentApprovalScope: decision wording / platform baseline only; NOT independent security or operational testing
